name: TableStyle
description: Represents a single style that can be applied to a table.
remarks: Use the Table property of the Styles object to return a TableStyle object. Use the Borders property to apply borders to an entire table. Use the Condition method to apply borders or shading only to specified sections of a table. This example creates a new table style and formats the table with a surrounding border. Special borders and shading are applied to the first and last rows and the last column.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TableStyle object.

properties.name: AllowPageBreaks
properties.description: Allows Microsoft Word to break the specified table across pages. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified object.

properties.name: BottomPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add below the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: LeftPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the left of the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TopPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add above the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RightPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the right of the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdRowAlignment constant that represents the alignment for the specified table style. Read/write.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the spacing (in points) between the cells in a table style. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TableDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which Microsoft Word orders cells in the specified table style. Read/write WdTableDirection.

properties.name: AllowBreakAcrossPage
properties.description: Sets or returns a Long indicating whether lines in the rows of tables formatted with a specified style break across pages. Read/write.

properties.name: LeftIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the left indent value (in points) for the rows in the specified table style. Read/write.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified table style.

properties.name: RowStripe
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the number of rows to include in the banding when a style specifies odd- or even-row banding. Read/write.

properties.name: ColumnStripe
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the number of columns in the banding when a style specifies odd- or even-column banding. Read/write.

methods.name: Condition
methods.description: Returns a ConditionalStyle object that represents special style formatting for a portion of a table.

parameters.name: ConditionCode
parameters.description: The area of the table to which to apply the formatting.
